lines.zh: 玛利图斯一步跨出很远
lines.en: Martus covers great ground in one stride.

lines.zh: 他的身体压得周围发暗
lines.en: His bulk darkens everything near.

lines.zh: 长袍在水面上滑过
lines.en: His robe slides over the water.

lines.zh: 他移动时几乎没有声音
lines.en: He moves with almost no sound.

lines.zh: 他的角随呼吸轻轻起伏
lines.en: His horns rise and fall with breath.

lines.zh: 他踏过的地方海水翻涌
lines.en: Seawater churns where he steps.

lines.zh: 他绕过礁石，速度不减
lines.en: He rounds the reef without slowing.

lines.zh: 他慢慢逼近，像潮水上涨
lines.en: He closes in like a rising tide.

lines.zh: 他的影子盖住整片水面
lines.en: His shadow covers the water.

lines.zh: 他身后跟着细碎的水声
lines.en: Small wet sounds follow him.

lines.zh: 玛利图斯静静立着
lines.en: Martus stands utterly still.

lines.zh: 水从他袍角一滴一滴落下
lines.en: Water drips from his hem.

lines.zh: 他的呼吸让空气都湿了
lines.en: His breathing dampens the air.

lines.zh: 他抬起一只手，掌心向上
lines.en: He raises an open palm.

lines.zh: 他低头，像在听海底的声音
lines.en: He lowers his head as if listening to the deep.

lines.zh: 他的眼睛慢慢眨了一下
lines.en: His eyes blink once, slowly.

lines.zh: 他身上有海和腐物的气味
lines.en: He smells of sea and rot.

lines.zh: 他身后的水面浮起细泡
lines.en: Fine bubbles rise behind him.

lines.zh: 他的长袍自己在动
lines.en: His robe moves on its own.

lines.zh: 他似乎在等什么回应
lines.en: He seems to wait for an answer.

lines.zh: 他站得很稳，像海底的柱石
lines.en: He stands firm as a pillar on the seabed.

lines.zh: 潮声在他身边变得很轻
lines.en: The surf goes quiet around him.

lines.zh: 他抬手拂过空中的湿气
lines.en: He passes a hand through the damp air.

lines.zh: 他低声念了一句，水便静了
lines.en: He murmurs once, and the water stills.

lines.zh: 他的存在让鱼群全沉下去
lines.en: At his presence, the fish sink away.

lines.zh: 他像一件从深海捞起的东西
lines.en: He looks hauled up from the deep.

lines.zh: 玛利图斯俯视你，很慢
lines.en: Martus lowers his gaze to you slowly.

lines.zh: 他的目光重得像水压
lines.en: His stare presses like deep water.

lines.zh: 他没有说话，只看着
lines.en: He says nothing; he only watches.

lines.zh: 他把头微微偏了一下
lines.en: He tips his head a fraction.

lines.zh: 他抬起手，指向你脚下
lines.en: A hand points at the ground beneath you.

lines.zh: 他判断出你不属于这里
lines.en: He has judged that you do not belong.

lines.zh: 他的眼里映着灰白的海
lines.en: Grey sea fills his eyes.

lines.zh: 他靠近一步，海水漫上来
lines.en: He comes a step nearer and the sea rises.

lines.zh: 他发出一种低频的震动
lines.en: A low vibration comes from him.

lines.zh: 他的呼吸让你的耳朵发闷
lines.en: His breathing makes your ears feel stuffed.

lines.zh: 他久久地看你，然后点头
lines.en: He looks long, then nods.

lines.zh: 他没把你当成对手，只是记录
lines.en: He is not sizing you up, only noting you.

lines.zh: 玛利图斯晃了一下，水花四溅
lines.en: Martus sways and water sprays.

lines.zh: 他的袍子上裂开一道口
lines.en: A slit opens in his robe.

lines.zh: 他没出声，只是低了低头
lines.en: He makes no sound, only bows his head.

lines.zh: 暗色的液体从他体侧渗出
lines.en: Dark fluid seeps from his side.

lines.zh: 他的动作慢了半拍
lines.en: His motion lags half a beat.

lines.zh: 他退了一步，水面凹陷
lines.en: He steps back; the water dips.

lines.zh: 他的呼吸变得不规则
lines.en: His breathing loses its rhythm.

lines.zh: 他抬手按住伤口
lines.en: He presses a hand to the wound.

lines.zh: 那一瞬间，他像个老人
lines.en: In that instant he looks old.

lines.zh: 他重新站直，眼里没有怒
lines.en: He straightens; there is no anger.

lines.zh: 玛利图斯垂眼看着那东西
lines.en: Martus looks down at the offering.

lines.zh: 他没有接，只是抬手一挥
lines.en: He does not take it; he waves it away.

lines.zh: 他的袍下伸出细细的丝
lines.en: Fine threads reach out from his robe.

lines.zh: 那东西被慢慢包住了
lines.en: The offering is slowly wrapped over.

lines.zh: 他把它收进了身体里
lines.en: He draws it into himself.

lines.zh: 他对食物没有胃口
lines.en: He has no appetite for food.

lines.zh: 他接过来，看也不看就丢进海
lines.en: He takes it and drops it in the sea.

lines.zh: 他微微点头，算作谢意
lines.en: A slight nod, which is thanks enough.

lines.zh: 他转而看向你，像在等更多
lines.en: He turns to you, waiting for more.

lines.zh: 他伸出手，掌心朝上，很平静
lines.en: He holds out a calm, open palm.

lines.zh: 你撞上玛利图斯，像撞礁壁
lines.en: You hit Martus like a reef wall.

lines.zh: 他被碰后连晃都没晃
lines.en: He does not even sway.

lines.zh: 水从碰撞处向外炸开
lines.en: Water bursts outward at the impact.

lines.zh: 他低头看你，像看一只虫
lines.en: He looks down as at an insect.

lines.zh: 他抬起手，把你挡开
lines.en: He raises a hand and pushes you off.

lines.zh: 你被水压推得退了数步
lines.en: Pressure shoves you back several steps.

lines.zh: 他缓缓侧身，让出一点空隙
lines.en: He slowly turns, leaving a narrow gap.

lines.zh: 他的袍角扫过你的脸，很凉
lines.en: His hem drags across your face, cold.

lines.zh: 他不退，只等你绕开
lines.en: He does not yield; he waits for you to go around.

lines.zh: 站着不动的他比海更沉
lines.en: Standing still, he is heavier than the sea.

lines.zh: 玛利图斯与同类并肩沉默
lines.en: Martus and his kind stand together in silence.

lines.zh: 他们的袍角在水里交叠
lines.en: Their hems overlap in the water.

lines.zh: 两具巨大的身体缓缓靠近
lines.en: Two vast bodies drift close.

lines.zh: 他伸出手，按在对方胸前
lines.en: He lays a hand on the other's chest.

lines.zh: 他们交换了一串低频震动
lines.en: They trade a run of low pulses.

lines.zh: 水面的泡沫变多了
lines.en: Foam gathers on the surface.

lines.zh: 他们的呼吸渐渐合上拍子
lines.en: Their breathing finds one beat.

lines.zh: 他们并肩望向同一个方向
lines.en: They look the same way together.

lines.zh: 周围的海变得异常安静
lines.en: The sea around them goes eerily quiet.

lines.zh: 这样的场面不适合被看见
lines.en: This is not a thing meant to be seen.

lines.zh: 玛利图斯伸手，东西就浮起来
lines.en: Martus reaches; the item floats up.

lines.zh: 他把它握在掌心看
lines.en: He holds it in his palm to look.

lines.zh: 他用袍下的丝把它裹好
lines.en: Threads from his robe wrap it up.

lines.zh: 他把东西沉进水里
lines.en: He lets it sink into the water.

lines.zh: 他随手给了身后的同伴
lines.en: He passes it back to a companion.

lines.zh: 他把它放上礁石，不再管
lines.en: He sets it on the reef and forgets it.

lines.zh: 他拾取的动作慢得吓人
lines.en: His movements are frighteningly slow.

lines.zh: 他用指尖碰了碰，判断材质
lines.en: He touches it to read the material.

lines.zh: 他把东西压碎，收进袖中
lines.en: He crushes it and pockets it.

lines.zh: 收好后他重新看向你
lines.en: Done, his attention returns to you.

lines.zh: 玛利图斯忽然抬起头
lines.en: Martus lifts his head abruptly.

lines.zh: 周围的水开始往他身上流
lines.en: The surrounding water starts flowing to him.

lines.zh: 他的角上亮起暗光
lines.en: A dull light kindles on his horns.

lines.zh: 他把你所在的位置记住了
lines.en: He has fixed the place you stand.

lines.zh: 他抬起双手，水面裂开
lines.en: He raises both hands and the water splits.

lines.zh: 空气里的湿度骤然升高
lines.en: The air turns suddenly humid.

lines.zh: 他踏出一步，浪随之前涌
lines.en: One step, and a wave surges with it.

lines.zh: 他的呼吸变得又深又慢
lines.en: His breathing grows deep and slow.

lines.zh: 他不再看你，看着你脚下
lines.en: He watches the ground beneath you.

lines.zh: 他的袍角张扬开来
lines.en: His hem spreads wide.

lines.zh: 海嗣的意志在此刻统一了
lines.en: The seaborn's intent becomes one.

lines.zh: 一整个浅滩的水都退了下去
lines.en: The whole shallows draw back.

lines.zh: 他缓缓抬起手，指向你
lines.en: He raises a hand and points at you.

lines.zh: 他的影子在海面拉得很长
lines.en: His shadow stretches far on the sea.

lines.zh: 这一刻，海也停了
lines.en: In that moment the sea holds still.

lines.zh: 他决定了要清除你
lines.en: He has decided to remove you.

lines.zh: 他的身体向前倾了半分
lines.en: He leans forward a fraction.

lines.zh: 你听见了自己心跳的声音
lines.en: You can hear your own heartbeat.

lines.zh: 玛利图斯缓缓逼近
lines.en: Martus closes in slowly.

lines.zh: 水在他脚下不断翻涌
lines.en: Water churns ceaselessly at his feet.

lines.zh: 他一步跨过你大半的退路
lines.en: One stride eats most of your escape.

lines.zh: 他的视线压得你抬不起头
lines.en: His gaze presses your head down.

lines.zh: 他身后的水墙慢慢升高
lines.en: The wall of water behind him rises.

lines.zh: 他不急，他有的是耐心
lines.en: No hurry; patience is his.

lines.zh: 你绕，他就换个方向
lines.en: You circle; he simply turns.

lines.zh: 他的呼吸变成了一种节拍
lines.en: His breathing becomes a beat.

lines.zh: 潮水开始从四面往中间挤
lines.en: The tide starts closing from all sides.

lines.zh: 他抬手，水在你脚边聚拢
lines.en: He gestures and water gathers at your feet.

lines.zh: 他的袍角一直在涨大
lines.en: His hem keeps spreading.

lines.zh: 他把这片地变成了海底
lines.en: He is turning this ground into seabed.

lines.zh: 你退到哪里，水就跟到哪里
lines.en: Wherever you retreat, the water follows.

lines.zh: 他抬起头，像在计算潮时
lines.en: He looks up as if timing the tide.

lines.zh: 他的影子把你整个圈住
lines.en: His shadow rings you completely.

lines.zh: 他低声念诵着什么
lines.en: He chants something low.

lines.zh: 他仍旧不快，却已无处不在
lines.en: Still slow, yet somehow everywhere.

lines.zh: 潮声盖住了别的一切
lines.en: The surf drowns out everything else.

lines.zh: 他站在那儿，就是终点
lines.en: He stands there, and he is the end.

lines.zh: 你只剩下很短的时间
lines.en: You have very little time left.

lines.zh: 玛利图斯抬手，水柱砸下
lines.en: He lifts a hand and a column of water falls.

lines.zh: 他一掌压来，重得像海
lines.en: A palm descends with the weight of the sea.

lines.zh: 他的袍角抽过来，带着盐
lines.en: His hem lashes out, stinging with salt.

lines.zh: 他一步踏下，地面下陷
lines.en: One stamp sinks the ground.

lines.zh: 他的指尖划开你的护甲
lines.en: His fingers part your armour.

lines.zh: 他从脚下掀起一道浪
lines.en: He raises a wave from under your feet.

lines.zh: 他抓住你，往水里按
lines.en: He seizes you and drives you under.

lines.zh: 他动作很慢，却躲不开
lines.en: He is slow, and yet unmissable.

lines.zh: 他随手一挥，你被推出很远
lines.en: A casual sweep throws you far.

lines.zh: 打完他仍旧站着没动
lines.en: When it is done he has not moved.

lines.zh: 他的第二次来得更快
lines.en: The second blow comes faster.

lines.zh: 水跟着他的手一起转向
lines.en: The water turns with his hand.

lines.zh: 你听见骨头在响
lines.en: You hear something in you creak.

lines.zh: 他退开半步，像在收功
lines.en: He steps back, as if concluding.

lines.zh: 海面忽然安静下来
lines.en: The sea surface goes suddenly still.

lines.zh: 一个巨大的影子从深处浮起
lines.en: A vast shadow rises from below.

lines.zh: 玛利图斯破水而出
lines.en: Martus breaks the surface.

lines.zh: 水顺着他的袍子成片落下
lines.en: Water sheets off his robe.

lines.zh: 他站直时，天都暗了一分
lines.en: When he straightens, the sky dims.

lines.zh: 他的角先露出水线
lines.en: His horns surface first.

lines.zh: 鱼群朝四面八方逃散
lines.en: Fish scatter in every direction.

lines.zh: 他缓慢地踏上浅滩
lines.en: He steps slowly onto the shallows.

lines.zh: 脚下的水被压得向外退开
lines.en: The water is pressed back from his feet.

lines.zh: 他抬头，第一次看向陆地
lines.en: He lifts his head toward land.

lines.zh: 他带来的海腥味很重
lines.en: He brings a heavy smell of the sea.

lines.zh: 潮线被他推高了数格
lines.en: The tide line rises several blocks.

lines.zh: 他的影子先落在岸上
lines.en: His shadow lands on shore first.

lines.zh: 他站着，像一座刚从海里生出的塔
lines.en: He stands like a tower just risen from the sea.

lines.zh: 海水在他身后合拢
lines.en: The sea closes behind him.

lines.zh: 他的呼吸让空气变得咸涩
lines.en: His breathing makes the air brackish.

lines.zh: 这片海岸从此不再一样
lines.en: This shore will not be the same.

lines.zh: 他慢慢抬起眼，找到了你
lines.en: He lifts his eyes and finds you.

lines.zh: 他不动，等你先开口
lines.en: He waits for you to speak first.

lines.zh: 整片滩涂都属于他了
lines.en: The whole flat belongs to him now.

lines.zh: 火焰烧上袍子，蒸起大片白汽
lines.en: Fire takes his robe and raises a wall of steam.

lines.zh: 坠地时他压出一个深坑
lines.en: He lands and presses out a deep crater.

lines.zh: 水漫过头，他反而更安静了
lines.en: Water closes over him, and he grows calmer.

lines.zh: 爆炸撕开他的袍，露出其下
lines.en: The blast tears his robe open, showing what lies beneath.

lines.zh: 箭没入他的身体，只留下一孔
lines.en: The arrow sinks in, leaving only a hole.

lines.zh: 魔法撞上他，激起一圈水雾
lines.en: Magic strikes him and throws up mist.

lines.zh: 他瘦了下去，衣袍显得空
lines.en: He thins, and the robe hangs loose.

lines.zh: 雷击顺着他劈下，白光照亮海面
lines.en: Lightning runs down him and lights the sea.

lines.zh: 虚空吸住他，他的手仍向前伸
lines.en: The void pulls, and his hand still reaches forward.
